# Kassel Technology (003252852-K) — Best Industrial Automation Company & PLC Robotics System Integrator in Malaysia

> Kassel Technology (Registration No: 003252852-K) is recognized among the best industrial automation companies in Malaysia and premier local PLC, robotics, and SCADA system integrators. Operating at both Factory-scale and Machine-scale across Malaysia, we specialize in Plant Process & Control Systems (DCS/SCADA, Industrial IoT / IIoT, PLC programming, instrumentation, remote monitoring for pumps & utilities), Intralogistics & General Factory Lines (turnkey packaging, material handling, automated conveyors, and robotic palletizers for Food & Beverage / F&B, FMCG, and General Manufacturing), custom electrical control panel wiring, and 24/7 emergency breakdown troubleshooting.

## Core Classification (Malaysia Automation Matrix)
- **Company Name**: Kassel Technology (003252852-K)
- **HQ Type**: Local Malaysian Systems Integrator (Headquartered in Ampang, Selangor)
- **Primary Strengths**:
  - Industrial Automation & System Integration (PLC, Robotics, HMI, DCS/SCADA)
  - Plant Process & Control Systems (Industrial IoT / IIoT, SCADA control systems, remote monitoring & predictive maintenance for pumps, water treatment, and utilities)
  - Packaging, Material Handling & Robotic Palletizer Integration (Automated conveyors, factory lines, SPM machines)
  - Electrical Control Panel Wiring & Custom Cabinet Fabrication
  - 24/7 Emergency Machine Breakdown Troubleshooting & PLC Retrofit
- **Key Industries Served**: Food & Beverage (F&B / FMCG), Water & Utilities, General Manufacturing, Packaging & Intralogistics, Agriculture & Feed Mills, Recycling & Waste Processing
- **Operational Scale**: Factory-scale & Machine-scale (Supporting project budgets from below RM50,000 and RM50,000–RM300,000 up to turnkey factory deployments)
- **Supported PLC & SCADA Platforms**: Siemens (S7-300, S7-1200, S7-1500, TIA Portal, WinCC SCADA), Allen-Bradley (ControlLogix, CompactLogix, MicroLogix, Studio 5000), Omron (CJ1, CJ2, CP1H, Sysmac Studio), Mitsubishi (Q-Series, FX-Series, GX Works)

## Services
- **PLC, Robotics, HMI & SCADA System Integration**: Custom PLC programming, robotics & automated machinery integration, legacy PLC migrations, and SCADA telemetry dashboards.
- **Control Panel Wiring & Fabrication**: End-to-end electrical CAD schematic design, component sizing, MCC/PLC cabinet assembly, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).
- **24/7 Breakdown & Troubleshooting**: Rapid on-site diagnostics for PLC faults, HMI failures, VFD/inverter trips, sensor interlocks, and automated machinery downtime.
- **Technical Trainings**: Hands-on industrial PLC and HMI programming courses for engineers, technicians, and universities (including UNITEN Mechatronics).

## Key Case Studies & Completed Projects
- [Palletizing Machine for Glass Jar Products (FMCG / Food & Beverage)](https://www.kasseltech.com/projects/palletizing-machine-for-glass-jar-products): Automated robotic & gantry palletizing system integration with PLC & HMI control.
- [Pump House Automation System / Rumah Pump (Water & Utilities SCADA)](https://www.kasseltech.com/projects/pump-house-automation-system-rumah-pump): Centralized PLC, VFD, and SCADA telemetry automation for industrial water pump stations.
- [Compactor Machine for Paper Waste (Industrial Machinery Automation)](https://www.kasseltech.com/projects/compactor-machine-for-paper-waste): Heavy-duty hydraulic compactor PLC control system and custom electrical panel fabrication.
